title: Answer-from-result cases on overview and alerts payloads, Italian and English
goal: A model reads a tool result correctly
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposal 1 of the shared-asset review, coordinator:F-016-T04); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

Cases give a grover_overview or grover_alerts payload in the prompt and ask which pot is out of its phase range, since when, in Italian ("quale vaso è fuori range e da quando?") and English; exact-json on the pot, probe and level
The pack is tagged so NERV can run it (nerv:F-120-T11)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Payload fixtures plus about 6 cases. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the coordinator:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
